rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a car steering wheel.

example.english: When you drive, don't just stare at the steering wheel; pay attention to the road too.
example.traditional: 揸車嗰陣唔好淨係望住個軚盤，仲要留意路面。
example.jyutping: zaa1 ce1 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 mong6 zyu6 go3 taai5 pun4 zung6 jiu3 lau4 ji3 lou6 min2
